items.overview: After the death of their old college roommate who they haven't spoken to in years, Matt and Milo go to his funeral. Things grow intense as they are expected to give the eulogy.
items.title: Wilting Flowers

items.overview: Experimental narrative documentary on a fly who gets trapped beside an open window.  Dead Flies is a film about... a dead fly.
items.title: Dead Flies

items.overview: Two detectives race against time to interrogate a local mechanic, suspicious that he might be a notorious serial killer
items.title: Calling Card

items.overview: What does it mean to be a kid? A group of young snowboarders - Camille Armand, Enzo Scotto, and Quentin Ladame - set out to explore this question in the heart of the Japanese winter, where deep snow transforms the landscape into a endless playground.
items.title: Kids

items.original_title: Pure Elegance Tour: Live at History
items.overview: In this live concert film, Ninja Sex Party brings you the most tasteful and opulent experience known to humankind, a show full of genteel music addressing some of life's deepest mysteries: What does it feel like to own a car? To take a date to your parents' house? Or to board a spaceship to save a sexless future? Watch, and the answers shall reveal themselves to you forthwith!
items.title: Pure Elegance Tour: Live at History

items.overview: When three disillusioned friends stumble upon a religious commune, one of them embarks on a mission to discover the truth about the group's mysterious leader before it is too late...
items.title: Kingdom of Dust

items.overview: Influencer Chiara Ferragni opens up for the first time on the charity scandal that rocked her career and sparked the end of her high-profile marriage.
items.title: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing

items.overview: Exploring the influence of 1960s spy mania on the latter Supermarionation series, from Thunderbirds to The Secret Service.
items.title: The Last Spy-fi Series

items.overview: TV historian Matthew Sweet goes in search of the people, places and puppets that brought The Secret Service to life.
items.title: The Secret Service Revisited

items.overview: A hunting initiation rite ends in a dark pact of silence when a stray shot awakens a cursed legacy in the deep, secluded heart of the forest.
items.title: Paganos

items.overview: After years of infertility, Rocío takes in a street child as if he were her own son. Her obsession with motherhood triggers a domestic thriller that draws León into a world of marginalized children, secrets, and captivity.
items.title: Hijos

items.overview: Following the loss of his partner, David wanders the city, heartbroken and lost. By chance, he comes across an occult shop and decides to step inside for a tarot reading. After laying out the cards, the tarot reader hands him a piece of paper containing a set of instructions: perform a ritual and visit the cemetery at nightfall. As David arrives at the cemetery, overwhelmed by despair, he encounters a spectral presence that brings him comfort.
items.title: Beyond the beyond

items.overview: In the future, emotions and gestures have disappeared. But we are in the present: five researchers arrive on electric scooters in a village in the Basque Country, searching for what their time has forgotten. Through interviews and observation, they enter the intimacy of its inhabitants, until the boundaries between the different times begin to blur.
items.title: Bitartean, gero

items.overview: Mona lives alone in a working-class neighborhood. A sex worker and private party organizer, she leads a discreet life, far from prying eyes. One evening, on returning home after a night of heavy drinking, she finds a young man—not yet twenty—in a balaclava breaking into her apartment, while other hooded youths wreak havoc in the street outside, destroying and setting fire to everything in their path. Who is this young man? What does he want from her? Confronted by this mysterious intruder, Mona must face the secrets of her past as they suddenly resurface.
items.title: Hoods

items.original_title: រោងចក្រទឹកកក
items.overview: Khmer movie
items.title: Ice Factory Ghost

items.overview: A dark psychological thriller revolving around a mysterious killer, a series of unsettling events, and a story of revenge.
items.title: Revenge of Her : Evil Prevails

items.overview: We retrace the path that was used by the women who walked up to the penitentiary of Fort San Cristóbal to help political prisoners between 1934 and 1945, as Spain went through Republic, Civil War, and Franco’s dictatorship. We search for their footprints, listen to their voices. The earth remembers.
items.title: If the Birds Sing

items.overview: Wilson trapped in a suffocating labyrinth of solipsism and modern burnout. Over one sleepless night he searches for something with no name, until a black star appears: a repeating light, an immovable loss, bright and black at the same time.
items.title: BLACK STAR

items.overview: A group of strangers coming from different countries accepts a very exciting invite for Christmas. As they arrive at the location, they soon discover what are the real plans of the mastermind behind the whole thing.
items.title: Jingle Hell

items.overview: From the World Championships to the Diagonale des Fous and the UTMB, Blandine L’Hirondel takes us on a journey through the legendary races of ultra-trail running. This lively and sincere portrait explores her daily challenges: balancing her career as a gynecologist with the demands of elite-level competition, overcoming setbacks, and pushing herself to the limit.
items.title: Blandine

items.overview: An ayu sweetfish mutates into a giant monster, dubbed Ayura, and attacks the Gifu prefecture of Japan. Kaoru, an unassuming government worker, is suddenly tasked to pilot the giant robot "Meka-U" as an emergency effort to stop Ayura.
items.title: Ayura

items.overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.
items.title: Mustang

items.overview: follows a man who returns to a family farm inherited from his parents, only to uncover a terrifying truth that threatens his survival there. The film explores how family bonds between parents and children can become a source of both salvation and control.
items.title: Soulala

items.overview: Every winter, millions of fir trees are chopped down, admired, and thrown away. The film follows their journey above and below ground, from human rituals to the hidden life inside the trees. A story about trees that we celebrate by cutting them down.
items.title: Holy Wood Dust

items.overview: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.
items.title: Clashing Through the Snow

items.overview: An animated adventure about Jojo the Axolotl, taking on the world to find his family, set in a fantastically inspired Mexican lakeside.
items.title: Axolodyssey

items.overview: This film exposes the hidden dangers of dating apps driven by the urgent consumption of sex and entertainment. Behind simple profile pictures often hide pathological narcissists and ambiguous characters. Looking for fleeting encounters, they prey on vulnerable users through flattery and deception.  In this virtual world, emotional connection is entirely absent. Everyone becomes a mere object of desire in a perverse, addictive game of dominance and submission that detaches users from reality. Ultimately, the virtual realm takes over, leading to a profound depersonalization where human beings are completely stripped of their humanity.
items.title: The Other You

items.overview: Hassan struggles to make a living as a fisherman in a small coastal town, where the sea provides less each year. Isolated by his faith, his only moments of tenderness are with single mother Latifah and her young daughter. When an old friend offers a dangerous alternative, Hassan becomes trapped between judgement and action.
items.title: Waves of Silence

items.overview: Portrait of Mayan midwives who do ultrasounds with their hands, those who respect the nature of the living and that contrast with the modern world.
items.title: Sinahal, The Mayan Midwives

items.overview: The filmmaker reflects on the tale of a man and his struggles with religion.
items.title: Delirium

items.overview: A boy grows up dreaming of telling stories and making films, but his insecurities and lack of self-confidence hold him back. Now, as an adult, he makes one final attempt to pursue his passion.
items.title: Dreamer

items.overview: Two idiotic criminals (one a seasoned veteran and the other a bumbling wannabe) devise the perfect heist to raise enough money for a trip to Legoland.
items.title: The Post Office Job

items.overview: Might, mid twenties, is feeling lost in his career, confused about his purpose and direction. As he confronts tough emotions surrounding leaving his job, he runs into a unique stranger of his own conception who changes his world forever.
items.title: THE STRANGER

items.overview: As a myna bird undergoes cataract surgery, GLIMMER captures the fragile bond between the bird and its owner, revealing the depths of love, vulnerability, and the universal hope of preserving a life we cannot bear to lose. Through the tension and uncertainty surrounding the operation, we see the fragile space between fear and hope, and come to understand the profound connection between the deeply intertwined lives of the bird and its owner.
items.title: Glimmer

items.overview: A detective has less than an hour to get a mass murderer to commit to his crimes before he'll be let free. But little does he know of the psychological nightmare that's about to follow.
items.title: Killers

items.overview: Young influencer Agatha has an appointment with "Professionall Cetrified Clarvoyant" W. W. Bobbins, and it doesn't turn out the way she expected it to.
items.title: Waves

items.overview: As her husband's health declines, Eileen fills her days with errands, routines and constant motion — anything to avoid being still. Small tasks multiply, and time passes without being shared. But avoidance has its limits, and Eileen is running out of road.
items.title: Catch Yourself On

items.overview: A deal goes wrong, resulting in an epic masterpiece of all proportions
items.title: CAT'S OUTTA THE BAG

items.overview: After the sudden death of her husband, Serena seeks out the man who received his donated heart. As an unexpected intimacy grows between them, she’s soon forced to confront the truth about her grief and whether she can let go of the past.
items.title: Love that Remains

items.overview: Acclaimed Edmonton filmmaker Tom Radford met Vladimír Valenta, a star of the Academy Award-winning film Closely Watched Trains, shortly after Valenta fled to Edmonton following the Soviet invasion of Czechoslovakia in 1968. Radford’s documentary explores Valenta’s artistic and political struggles under communist rule, drawing compelling parallels with issues facing Alberta and Canada today.
items.title: Vladimír Valenta – The Edmonton Connection

items.overview: When a ride-along puts Hollywood actress Sadie Paige and Nashville detective Corey Gable in the path of a dangerous Tennessee crime family, this unlikely duo finds themselves in over their heads. Captured and trapped together with nothing in common but matching handcuffs, Sadie and Corey must learn to trust each other to survive.
items.title: Tennessee Ride Along

items.overview: Two filmmakers exchange postcards across three countries to tell the story of the only Spanish victim of enforced disappearance in Venezuela in 1967.
items.title: Jueves en el Broadway

items.original_title: 新臺灣日日新報ー暗路
items.title: After Taiwan Daily News - The Obscured Path (in progress)

items.overview: Johnny Johnson wants to be a foosball legend, like his dad. There’s just one problem- he’s really, REALLY bad at foosball. Also, his mother wants him to continue working at her diner instead of playing a silly game. So when Johnny runs into his dad’s former coach, he is determined to train in secret in order to play in the upcoming tournament - because when you foose, you never lose. Inspired by the 2022 unfinished MG&J Studios short film of the same name, FOOSED has everything you want in an underdog story - and more!
items.title: FOOSED

items.overview: An absurdist neo-noir comedy about two rival Soy Sauce distributors. Using student politics, manipulation and violence to get their revenge.
items.title: Soy Boy: The Soyfather

items.overview: Through a series of encounters between a researcher, a beekeeper, and a group of children, the film explores the intertwined relationships between bees, beeswax, and mourning in the Basque Country.
items.title: Guretako eztia

items.overview: People, objects, and places have changed the way they relate—or at least, that’s how Oihana perceives it. Now the emptiness takes up space. A path, a window, a bed, a wardrobe, a mirror. With these, and what fits into a hiking backpack, she has all she needs to reset her coordinates and rest.
items.title: Neska bat desagertu da

items.original_title: こわれたビデオカメラによせて
items.title: My Video Camera Broke

items.overview: Nazaré is the most intense and unpredictable surfing arena on earth. Undercurrents follows 16-year-old Brit Imari Hearn as she joins forces with big wave charger Laura Crane to face down the Portuguese behemoth for the very first time. More than just a surfing spectacle, it’s an intimate exploration of mentorship, resilience, and the bond forged between two women taking on a formidable lineup and a male-dominated industry together.
items.title: Undercurrents

items.overview: What happens when we slow down and let the landscape set the pace? The film follows a six-day journey through the Cairngorms National Park. Two humans, two dogs and one pony, travelling through ancient Caledonian pine forests, across wild rivers and beneath the vast mountains of the Scottish Highlands. Moving slowly, carrying what they need and allowing the landscape and animals to dictate the journey.
items.title: Slowly Through the Red Mountains

items.overview: Milly's life is in shambles - she loses her job and her boyfriend all in one day. And if she can't come up with £96,000 pounds in 6 weeks, she'll also lose her lovely London home to her cheating ex. Lucky for her, an idle wish over a carved wooden elf changes everything. With a little Christmas magic, Milly is amazed to discover she is the sole beneficiary of her old neighbour's will. She has inherited a farm in the countryside. But to her dismay, all is not as rosy as it seems. The farm is falling apart and city girl Milly is out of her depth. But she refuses to give up and that determination earns her the respect of the locals, including a handsome horse trainer, Jack. Milly battles bad weather, the chaos of the farm and dodgy developers in an attempt to save the farm and get her flat back. And maybe, just maybe, find a little love along the way.
items.title: A Country Christmas Wish

items.overview: East Side High seniors discover a haunted Lotería deck where every card they’re dealt exposes who they truly are and the horrifying way they’ll die.
items.title: Lotería

items.overview: Set along British Columbia’s remote Dean River, the film follows 9-year-old Oly Hickman as he moves through his family’s fishing lodge in the heart of steelhead country.
items.title: Oly's Dean

items.overview: Follow Susan Baur, the 85-year-old leader, and her crew of fearless women as they defy limits, protect the environment, and rediscover wonder and joy through water and community.
items.title: Old Ladies Against Underwater Garbage

items.overview: From a shy, small-town kid to competing on the biggest stage in freeride mountain biking, Kristen’s journey shows what can happen when you give yourself permission to try.
items.title: Kirsten Van Horne - Rising Tide

items.overview: When night falls, director Julian Flavin hosts a radio show, pondering the meaning and scope, both latent and overt, of music. Guided by an enthralling voice and a camera that captures time suspended in the city at night, In The Sweet Arms shows music in its most unusual forms: a choir singing to those on their deathbeds, a U.S. Army rock group rehearsal, a superstar moved by the crowd during a concert, a teenager setting Call of Duty clips to music, an AI-generated song mimicking the band that the filmmaker once belonged to. These encounters probe the ideological, social and political dimensions of music and what it reveals about how we see the world.
items.title: In the Sweet Arms

items.overview: Tim is an ordinary student who enjoys spending his free time playing video games. When his mother tells him that she won't be home in the mornings for the next two weeks, Tim sees an opportunity to immerse himself even further in his virtual world, unaware of the consequences his decision might bring.
items.title: Kill You!

items.overview: This short documentary highlights the voices of Indigenous peoples in Marin county, California and their relationships with land, language, and cultural preservation.
items.title: The Land Still Speaks

items.original_title: Escape the Indoors: A 5pm-9am Cargo Bike Adventure
items.overview: School's out and the cargo bike is loaded. One night, one tent, one bag of marshmallows. World-class cyclist Tracy Moseley and family swap four walls for moonlight, time outside, s'mores by the campfire and a spot of rain.
items.title: Escape the Indoors: A 5pm-9am Cargo Bike Adventure

items.overview: A people-led climate documentary rooted in Cornwall, where stories, science and surfing come together to reveal how restoring the connections between land, sea and community could change everything.
items.title: No Trees, No Seas

items.original_title: Forgotten Founder: The Untold Story of Samson Occom and Dartmouth
items.overview: Despite his central role in the founding of Dartmouth College, Samson Occom, a Mohegan minister, educator and Indigenous intellectual, was erased from the historical record along with the promises made to Native communities.
items.title: Forgotten Founder: The Untold Story of Samson Occom and Dartmouth

items.overview: This short documentary highlights the voices of Indigenous peoples in Marin county, California and their relationships with land, language, and cultural preservation.
items.title: The Land Still Speaks

items.original_title: Escape the Indoors: A 5pm-9am Cargo Bike Adventure
items.overview: School's out and the cargo bike is loaded. One night, one tent, one bag of marshmallows. World-class cyclist Tracy Moseley and family swap four walls for moonlight, time outside, s'mores by the campfire and a spot of rain.
items.title: Escape the Indoors: A 5pm-9am Cargo Bike Adventure

items.overview: A people-led climate documentary rooted in Cornwall, where stories, science and surfing come together to reveal how restoring the connections between land, sea and community could change everything.
items.title: No Trees, No Seas

items.original_title: Forgotten Founder: The Untold Story of Samson Occom and Dartmouth
items.overview: Despite his central role in the founding of Dartmouth College, Samson Occom, a Mohegan minister, educator and Indigenous intellectual, was erased from the historical record along with the promises made to Native communities.
items.title: Forgotten Founder: The Untold Story of Samson Occom and Dartmouth

items.overview: One day, when photographer Momoko is eating lunch at a cafe, a university student studying film production asks her to appear in their graduation film. On the day of the shoot, the man cast to play her father turns out to be her real father, who she hasn't seen for years.
items.title: A Song from Beyond

items.overview: In times of the Belle Époque. Amidst a thriving society a young woman no longer recognizes herself. She has lost her inner light. In her desperation, the woman seeks out a peculiar place where someone has supposedly developed a new method for treating such deep inner darkness.
items.title: LVX

items.overview: Laura Orson, a disabled elderly woman, has nightmares of a startling creature that begin to haunt her daily life. As she grapples with her guilt over her deceased father, the creature closes in until she has no choice but to ask for help.
items.title: This Land

items.original_title: ម៉ែអើយ ផ្កាយរះក្នុងខ្លួនកូន
items.overview: This 65 min documentary feature an all-female drumming troop, Medha, from Siem Reap, Cambodia who symbolizes resilience and empowerment. Through powerful performances and intimate glimpses into their daily lives, the film sheds light on their courage to pursue their passion for the arts while navigating societal challenges, advocating for women’s rights, and raising their children as single mothers. This documentary not only celebrates the strength of remarkable women but also highlights the transformative power of music, exploring its deep, hereditary roots.
items.title: Mother, There’s a Star in Me

items.overview: TTFC-exclusive movie of Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity that takes place in a parallel universe, featuring the main cast in different roles: a mysterious alien named Amigo appears before an elementary school student named Taiyo! Amigo, who came to Earth for a certain investigation, asks Taiyo for his cooperation, but Taiyo is completely bewildered by the strange request. Amigo says "On my planet, it's so much easier to become friends", and Taiyo gets dragged into the situation. Will friendship blossom between the boy and the alien?
items.title: Nice to Meet You, Amigo

items.overview: Take a mouthwatering local adventure around New York City’s surf and ethnic food scene through a diverse crew of women who share waves, meals and personal narratives that express the rich flavor of NYC's surf community and diverse immigrant heritage... reflecting just how yummy it is. The film presents a rare view of New York City where the concrete jungle/city of dreams intersects with the vast richness of nature at its doorstep. The film also blasts the status quo representation of surf culture.
items.title: Surf. Eat. Repeat

items.overview: The one thing identical twins — quiet and bookish Abigail and globe-trotting event planner Charlie — can agree on is that this first Christmas without their mom will be difficult. When they unexpectedly get a last-minute chance to travel to Wales and spend a week running the Story Shoppe, an AirBnb/bookshop in Hay-on-Wye, they jump at the opportunity. Abigail is particularly excited, given the town’s role as the backdrop of the bestselling Winterton Chronicles, her all-time favorite Regency holiday romances.
items.title: Double Booked for the Holidays

items.overview: A montage of unconnected scenes and vignettes showcasing all kinds of folk depravity and foul ecstasy.
items.title: Heretical Girls

items.overview: In a quiet house, Leonor spends her days in near-constant solitude, while her mother, Diana, works tirelessly around the clock to support them. One night, after a terrifying experience in her room, Diana tries to comfort her by giving her a puppy, hoping its companionship will help her sleep peacefully. At first, the dog becomes her refuge and inseparable companion. But when the shadows begin to move again and the strange noises return, Leonor will discover that not everything that licks her hand in the dark is her pet.
items.title: Not Only Dogs Lick

items.original_title: Nio Ko Bokk (This Belongs to All of Us)
items.overview: Pape and Seydi are two young men who find purpose and community in the ocean, choosing a different path than the perilous journeys many peers take in search of opportunity abroad. Through their story, the film explores how belonging at home can be as powerful as the promise of elsewhere.
items.title: Nio Ko Bokk (This Belongs to All of Us)

items.overview: In 2024, Ashley Parsons and Quentin Boëhm set themselves the mission of bringing their three Kyrgyz horses back home to the French Alps. From Poland to France, they travel 3000km on horseback through the mountains of Europe.
items.title: Le Sabot Montagnard

items.original_title: I'm Right Over Here, Why Can't You See Me?
items.overview: In November 2024, a teenage girl vanished from her home in broad daylight. It was her sixteenth birthday.
items.title: I'm Right Over Here, Why Can't You See Me?

items.overview: After surviving an abusive past, Yorkshire mother Tahira discovers strength through trail running. Supported by a running community, she rebuilds her confidence and begins helping others find healing and freedom in the outdoors.
items.title: Tahira

items.overview: Kindred Roots (La Sangre Llama) follows the journey of Zapotec migrants from a small town in San Bartolomé Zoogocho, Oaxaca, Mexico. With a collective dream to improve and modernize their hometown, they assembled a community in a land far from home. In their efforts to realize this goal, they established the hometown association within the Union Social Zoogochense (USZ), which connected their cultural roots through community and replicated a sense of belonging in Los Angeles.
items.title: Kindred Roots

items.overview: Following the Trojan War, a soldier facing death encounters Thanatos and is drawn into a mythological confrontation about life, fate, and the meaninglessness of war.
items.title: Fallen From Olympus

results.overview: After the death of their old college roommate who they haven't spoken to in years, Matt and Milo go to his funeral. Things grow intense as they are expected to give the eulogy.

results.overview: An animated adventure about Jojo the Axolotl, taking on the world to find his family, set in a fantastically inspired Mexican lakeside.
results.title: Axolodyssey

results.overview: This film exposes the hidden dangers of dating apps driven by the urgent consumption of sex and entertainment. Behind simple profile pictures often hide pathological narcissists and ambiguous characters. Looking for fleeting encounters, they prey on vulnerable users through flattery and deception.  In this virtual world, emotional connection is entirely absent. Everyone becomes a mere object of desire in a perverse, addictive game of dominance and submission that detaches users from reality. Ultimately, the virtual realm takes over, leading to a profound depersonalization where human beings are completely stripped of their humanity.
results.title: The Other You

results.overview: Hassan struggles to make a living as a fisherman in a small coastal town, where the sea provides less each year. Isolated by his faith, his only moments of tenderness are with single mother Latifah and her young daughter. When an old friend offers a dangerous alternative, Hassan becomes trapped between judgement and action.
results.title: Waves of Silence

results.overview: Portrait of Mayan midwives who do ultrasounds with their hands, those who respect the nature of the living and that contrast with the modern world.
results.title: Sinahal, The Mayan Midwives

results.overview: The filmmaker reflects on the tale of a man and his struggles with religion.
results.title: Delirium

results.overview: A boy grows up dreaming of telling stories and making films, but his insecurities and lack of self-confidence hold him back. Now, as an adult, he makes one final attempt to pursue his passion.
results.title: Dreamer

results.overview: Two idiotic criminals (one a seasoned veteran and the other a bumbling wannabe) devise the perfect heist to raise enough money for a trip to Legoland.
results.title: The Post Office Job

results.overview: Might, mid twenties, is feeling lost in his career, confused about his purpose and direction. As he confronts tough emotions surrounding leaving his job, he runs into a unique stranger of his own conception who changes his world forever.
results.title: THE STRANGER

results.overview: As a myna bird undergoes cataract surgery, GLIMMER captures the fragile bond between the bird and its owner, revealing the depths of love, vulnerability, and the universal hope of preserving a life we cannot bear to lose. Through the tension and uncertainty surrounding the operation, we see the fragile space between fear and hope, and come to understand the profound connection between the deeply intertwined lives of the bird and its owner.
results.title: Glimmer

results.overview: A detective has less than an hour to get a mass murderer to commit to his crimes before he'll be let free. But little does he know of the psychological nightmare that's about to follow.
results.title: Killers

results.overview: Young influencer Agatha has an appointment with "Professionall Cetrified Clarvoyant" W. W. Bobbins, and it doesn't turn out the way she expected it to.
results.title: Waves

results.overview: As her husband's health declines, Eileen fills her days with errands, routines and constant motion — anything to avoid being still. Small tasks multiply, and time passes without being shared. But avoidance has its limits, and Eileen is running out of road.
results.title: Catch Yourself On

results.overview: A deal goes wrong, resulting in an epic masterpiece of all proportions
results.title: CAT'S OUTTA THE BAG

results.overview: After the sudden death of her husband, Serena seeks out the man who received his donated heart. As an unexpected intimacy grows between them, she’s soon forced to confront the truth about her grief and whether she can let go of the past.
results.title: Love that Remains

results.overview: Acclaimed Edmonton filmmaker Tom Radford met Vladimír Valenta, a star of the Academy Award-winning film Closely Watched Trains, shortly after Valenta fled to Edmonton following the Soviet invasion of Czechoslovakia in 1968. Radford’s documentary explores Valenta’s artistic and political struggles under communist rule, drawing compelling parallels with issues facing Alberta and Canada today.
results.title: Vladimír Valenta – The Edmonton Connection

results.overview: When a ride-along puts Hollywood actress Sadie Paige and Nashville detective Corey Gable in the path of a dangerous Tennessee crime family, this unlikely duo finds themselves in over their heads. Captured and trapped together with nothing in common but matching handcuffs, Sadie and Corey must learn to trust each other to survive.
results.title: Tennessee Ride Along

results.overview: Two filmmakers exchange postcards across three countries to tell the story of the only Spanish victim of enforced disappearance in Venezuela in 1967.
results.title: Jueves en el Broadway

results.original_title: 新臺灣日日新報ー暗路
results.title: After Taiwan Daily News - The Obscured Path (in progress)

results.overview: Johnny Johnson wants to be a foosball legend, like his dad. There’s just one problem- he’s really, REALLY bad at foosball. Also, his mother wants him to continue working at her diner instead of playing a silly game. So when Johnny runs into his dad’s former coach, he is determined to train in secret in order to play in the upcoming tournament - because when you foose, you never lose. Inspired by the 2022 unfinished MG&J Studios short film of the same name, FOOSED has everything you want in an underdog story - and more!
results.title: FOOSED

results.overview: An absurdist neo-noir comedy about two rival Soy Sauce distributors. Using student politics, manipulation and violence to get their revenge.
results.title: Soy Boy: The Soyfather

results.overview: Through a series of encounters between a researcher, a beekeeper, and a group of children, the film explores the intertwined relationships between bees, beeswax, and mourning in the Basque Country.
results.title: Guretako eztia

results.overview: People, objects, and places have changed the way they relate—or at least, that’s how Oihana perceives it. Now the emptiness takes up space. A path, a window, a bed, a wardrobe, a mirror. With these, and what fits into a hiking backpack, she has all she needs to reset her coordinates and rest.
results.title: Neska bat desagertu da

results.original_title: こわれたビデオカメラによせて
results.title: My Video Camera Broke

results.overview: Nazaré is the most intense and unpredictable surfing arena on earth. Undercurrents follows 16-year-old Brit Imari Hearn as she joins forces with big wave charger Laura Crane to face down the Portuguese behemoth for the very first time. More than just a surfing spectacle, it’s an intimate exploration of mentorship, resilience, and the bond forged between two women taking on a formidable lineup and a male-dominated industry together.
results.title: Undercurrents

results.overview: What happens when we slow down and let the landscape set the pace? The film follows a six-day journey through the Cairngorms National Park. Two humans, two dogs and one pony, travelling through ancient Caledonian pine forests, across wild rivers and beneath the vast mountains of the Scottish Highlands. Moving slowly, carrying what they need and allowing the landscape and animals to dictate the journey.
results.title: Slowly Through the Red Mountains

results.overview: Milly's life is in shambles - she loses her job and her boyfriend all in one day. And if she can't come up with £96,000 pounds in 6 weeks, she'll also lose her lovely London home to her cheating ex. Lucky for her, an idle wish over a carved wooden elf changes everything. With a little Christmas magic, Milly is amazed to discover she is the sole beneficiary of her old neighbour's will. She has inherited a farm in the countryside. But to her dismay, all is not as rosy as it seems. The farm is falling apart and city girl Milly is out of her depth. But she refuses to give up and that determination earns her the respect of the locals, including a handsome horse trainer, Jack. Milly battles bad weather, the chaos of the farm and dodgy developers in an attempt to save the farm and get her flat back. And maybe, just maybe, find a little love along the way.
results.title: A Country Christmas Wish

results.overview: East Side High seniors discover a haunted Lotería deck where every card they’re dealt exposes who they truly are and the horrifying way they’ll die.
results.title: Lotería

results.overview: Set along British Columbia’s remote Dean River, the film follows 9-year-old Oly Hickman as he moves through his family’s fishing lodge in the heart of steelhead country.
results.title: Oly's Dean

results.overview: Follow Susan Baur, the 85-year-old leader, and her crew of fearless women as they defy limits, protect the environment, and rediscover wonder and joy through water and community.
results.title: Old Ladies Against Underwater Garbage

results.overview: From a shy, small-town kid to competing on the biggest stage in freeride mountain biking, Kristen’s journey shows what can happen when you give yourself permission to try.
results.title: Kirsten Van Horne - Rising Tide

results.overview: When night falls, director Julian Flavin hosts a radio show, pondering the meaning and scope, both latent and overt, of music. Guided by an enthralling voice and a camera that captures time suspended in the city at night, In The Sweet Arms shows music in its most unusual forms: a choir singing to those on their deathbeds, a U.S. Army rock group rehearsal, a superstar moved by the crowd during a concert, a teenager setting Call of Duty clips to music, an AI-generated song mimicking the band that the filmmaker once belonged to. These encounters probe the ideological, social and political dimensions of music and what it reveals about how we see the world.
results.title: In the Sweet Arms

results.overview: Tim is an ordinary student who enjoys spending his free time playing video games. When his mother tells him that she won't be home in the mornings for the next two weeks, Tim sees an opportunity to immerse himself even further in his virtual world, unaware of the consequences his decision might bring.
results.title: Kill You!

results.overview: This short documentary highlights the voices of Indigenous peoples in Marin county, California and their relationships with land, language, and cultural preservation.
results.title: The Land Still Speaks

results.original_title: Escape the Indoors: A 5pm-9am Cargo Bike Adventure
results.overview: School's out and the cargo bike is loaded. One night, one tent, one bag of marshmallows. World-class cyclist Tracy Moseley and family swap four walls for moonlight, time outside, s'mores by the campfire and a spot of rain.
results.title: Escape the Indoors: A 5pm-9am Cargo Bike Adventure

results.overview: A people-led climate documentary rooted in Cornwall, where stories, science and surfing come together to reveal how restoring the connections between land, sea and community could change everything.
results.title: No Trees, No Seas

results.original_title: Forgotten Founder: The Untold Story of Samson Occom and Dartmouth
results.overview: Despite his central role in the founding of Dartmouth College, Samson Occom, a Mohegan minister, educator and Indigenous intellectual, was erased from the historical record along with the promises made to Native communities.
results.title: Forgotten Founder: The Untold Story of Samson Occom and Dartmouth

results.overview: This short documentary highlights the voices of Indigenous peoples in Marin county, California and their relationships with land, language, and cultural preservation.
results.title: The Land Still Speaks

results.title: No Trees, No Seas

results.overview: Despite his central role in the founding of Dartmouth College, Samson Occom, a Mohegan minister, educator and Indigenous intellectual, was erased from the historical record along with the promises made to Native communities.

results.overview: One day, when photographer Momoko is eating lunch at a cafe, a university student studying film production asks her to appear in their graduation film. On the day of the shoot, the man cast to play her father turns out to be her real father, who she hasn't seen for years.
results.title: A Song from Beyond

results.overview: In times of the Belle Époque. Amidst a thriving society a young woman no longer recognizes herself. She has lost her inner light. In her desperation, the woman seeks out a peculiar place where someone has supposedly developed a new method for treating such deep inner darkness.
results.title: LVX

results.overview: Laura Orson, a disabled elderly woman, has nightmares of a startling creature that begin to haunt her daily life. As she grapples with her guilt over her deceased father, the creature closes in until she has no choice but to ask for help.
results.title: This Land

results.original_title: ម៉ែអើយ ផ្កាយរះក្នុងខ្លួនកូន
results.overview: This 65 min documentary feature an all-female drumming troop, Medha, from Siem Reap, Cambodia who symbolizes resilience and empowerment. Through powerful performances and intimate glimpses into their daily lives, the film sheds light on their courage to pursue their passion for the arts while navigating societal challenges, advocating for women’s rights, and raising their children as single mothers. This documentary not only celebrates the strength of remarkable women but also highlights the transformative power of music, exploring its deep, hereditary roots.
results.title: Mother, There’s a Star in Me

results.overview: TTFC-exclusive movie of Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity that takes place in a parallel universe, featuring the main cast in different roles: a mysterious alien named Amigo appears before an elementary school student named Taiyo! Amigo, who came to Earth for a certain investigation, asks Taiyo for his cooperation, but Taiyo is completely bewildered by the strange request. Amigo says "On my planet, it's so much easier to become friends", and Taiyo gets dragged into the situation. Will friendship blossom between the boy and the alien?
results.title: Nice to Meet You, Amigo

results.overview: Take a mouthwatering local adventure around New York City’s surf and ethnic food scene through a diverse crew of women who share waves, meals and personal narratives that express the rich flavor of NYC's surf community and diverse immigrant heritage... reflecting just how yummy it is. The film presents a rare view of New York City where the concrete jungle/city of dreams intersects with the vast richness of nature at its doorstep. The film also blasts the status quo representation of surf culture.
results.title: Surf. Eat. Repeat

results.overview: The one thing identical twins — quiet and bookish Abigail and globe-trotting event planner Charlie — can agree on is that this first Christmas without their mom will be difficult. When they unexpectedly get a last-minute chance to travel to Wales and spend a week running the Story Shoppe, an AirBnb/bookshop in Hay-on-Wye, they jump at the opportunity. Abigail is particularly excited, given the town’s role as the backdrop of the bestselling Winterton Chronicles, her all-time favorite Regency holiday romances.
results.title: Double Booked for the Holidays

results.overview: A montage of unconnected scenes and vignettes showcasing all kinds of folk depravity and foul ecstasy.
results.title: Heretical Girls

results.overview: In a quiet house, Leonor spends her days in near-constant solitude, while her mother, Diana, works tirelessly around the clock to support them. One night, after a terrifying experience in her room, Diana tries to comfort her by giving her a puppy, hoping its companionship will help her sleep peacefully. At first, the dog becomes her refuge and inseparable companion. But when the shadows begin to move again and the strange noises return, Leonor will discover that not everything that licks her hand in the dark is her pet.
results.title: Not Only Dogs Lick

results.original_title: Nio Ko Bokk (This Belongs to All of Us)
results.overview: Pape and Seydi are two young men who find purpose and community in the ocean, choosing a different path than the perilous journeys many peers take in search of opportunity abroad. Through their story, the film explores how belonging at home can be as powerful as the promise of elsewhere.
results.title: Nio Ko Bokk (This Belongs to All of Us)

results.overview: In 2024, Ashley Parsons and Quentin Boëhm set themselves the mission of bringing their three Kyrgyz horses back home to the French Alps. From Poland to France, they travel 3000km on horseback through the mountains of Europe.
results.title: Le Sabot Montagnard

results.original_title: I'm Right Over Here, Why Can't You See Me?
results.overview: In November 2024, a teenage girl vanished from her home in broad daylight. It was her sixteenth birthday.
results.title: I'm Right Over Here, Why Can't You See Me?

results.overview: After surviving an abusive past, Yorkshire mother Tahira discovers strength through trail running. Supported by a running community, she rebuilds her confidence and begins helping others find healing and freedom in the outdoors.
results.title: Tahira

results.overview: Kindred Roots (La Sangre Llama) follows the journey of Zapotec migrants from a small town in San Bartolomé Zoogocho, Oaxaca, Mexico. With a collective dream to improve and modernize their hometown, they assembled a community in a land far from home. In their efforts to realize this goal, they established the hometown association within the Union Social Zoogochense (USZ), which connected their cultural roots through community and replicated a sense of belonging in Los Angeles.
results.title: Kindred Roots

results.overview: Following the Trojan War, a soldier facing death encounters Thanatos and is drawn into a mythological confrontation about life, fate, and the meaninglessness of war.
results.title: Fallen From Olympus
